documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 to ₹ 472.2 crores, while EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY to ₹ 92.3 crores. The company is executing an ongoing ₹ 200 crore debottlenecking capex funded through internal accruals to expand ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA. Commissioning of the expanded capacity is targeted by 30th September, 2026, with optimal utilization expected by the end of FY28. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet while catering to growing demand across automotive and consumer durable sectors. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue from operations of INR 1,276.0 crores in FY26, down 8.7% YoY, while full-year EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores with a 20.0% margin.

guidance.claim: Management expects optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

guidance.claim: Commissioning of the company's enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September 2026.
guidance.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and automotive sectors continue to dominate global ABS resin demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating ABS consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward higher-margin specialty and colored grades away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for ABS will be driven by growth in consumer durables and automotive sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: Passenger vehicle and two-wheeler sales reached record numbers in FY 2025-26, indicating sustained consumer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Passenger vehicle sales reached a record 46.43 lakh units in FY 2025-26, while two-wheeler sales crossed 2.17 crore units, indicating sustained consumer demand and favourable industry fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances remains positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Accordingly, the long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances remains positive.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion implementation from 75,000 TPA to 100,000 TPA is in progress with orders placed for critical equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, with EBITDA margins standing at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with EBITDA margins reaching 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42% while net profit margin stood at 14.14%.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume achieved in FY 2025-26 was 71,601 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved production volume of 71601 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for FY 2025-26 stood at 71,501 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume stood at 71501 TPA (Previous year - 74381 TPA).

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with zero gross debt to equity.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared three interim dividends of Re. 1 each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to hold Zero Debt status.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects to sustain operations through internal accruals without changes in its financing pattern.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's ABS business is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuation risks due to import dependence for key raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

management_commitments.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the expanded ABS capacity is expected to be completed by end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
